note: Subject texts of the Ice Folk faction (bead pulp_wars-7g3.5, docs/art/factions/ICE_FOLK.md). The faction has fixed colours: warm white and cream fur shaded warm taupe, charcoal slate faces on the beasts, dark brown-grey hide, ivory bone and one ice-blue accent; no owner colour.

subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:FIGHTER: Subject: Yeti, a chunky cute snow ape, broad and upright, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short wide body covered in shaggy fur, long strong arms with big dark slate hands and short legs with big dark slate feet: a dark slate blue-grey face with small bright friendly eyes, a wide mouth with two small white fangs and shaggy fur framing the face; one big chunky club of pale ivory bone crusted with ice crystals held in one hand; simple shapes and very few details; clearly an ape, not a person in furs.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:RAIDER: Subject: Sled, a small low dog sled racing forward: two chunky cute husky dogs with grey backs and white faces and bellies pulling in front, a short pale ivory bone sled with curved runners behind them, and a small fur-clad driver standing on the back of the sled with weathered tan skin, a dark brown-grey fur parka with a cream fur hood, whirling a bolas over his head: two round ice crystal weights on one cord; simple shapes and very few details; fast and low, wider than it is tall; the runners and the paws are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:MARKSMAN: Subject: Snow Hunter, a chunky cute lean ice-age hunter with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a friendly face with weathered light tan skin and rosy cheeks, a dark brown-grey fur parka with a big cream fur-trimmed hood up, dark brown-grey fur boots; one long pale ivory bone harpoon with a sharp ice crystal tip held ready to throw in one raised hand; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a hunter who strikes from range, the only person of the roster besides the witch.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:GUARD: Subject: Mammoth, a chunky cute woolly mammoth: a big round body covered in long shaggy warm cream-to-tan wool, a big domed head with small dark friendly eyes, a curled trunk, two long curved pale ivory tusks raised forward with frost on their tips, four short thick legs with dark slate feet and a small tail; wide and heavy; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN: Subject: Ice Witch, a chunky cute young witch with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a pale cream face with rosy cheeks and big friendly eyes, long straight snow-white hair, and on her head a tall crown of sharp ice crystal shards; a long deep navy blue robe trimmed with white frost along the hem and the sleeves and a short white fur collar; a tall pale ivory staff topped with one big ice crystal held up in one hand, and a few small white snowflakes swirling around her; no hat; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a queen of winter.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT: Subject: Boulder Yeti, a big heavy chunky cute snow ape, bigger and bulkier than a plain yeti, with a huge round head and a wide body covered in shaggy warm cream fur shaded taupe grey, a dark charcoal slate face, big dark slate hands and feet; it lifts one big round grey boulder crusted with ice crystals high above its head in both hands, ready to throw; wide braced legs; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a thrower of boulders.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:KNIGHT: Subject: Sabretooth, a chunky cute sabre-toothed cat in mid-prowl, long and low, with no rider: a pale cream-white snow-leopard coat with a few soft taupe-grey spots on the back, a big round head with small bright eyes and two huge long curved ivory fangs hanging below the jaw, a short thick tail, four big paws with dark slate pads, and a few small ice crystals of frost on its shoulders; simple shapes and very few details; the paws are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:ICE_FOLK:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Frost Giant, a huge towering chunky giant of ice and rock, far taller than a man: a big round head with a long frosty white beard and small bright friendly eyes, skin of dark slate grey stone, broad shoulders covered by big plates of ice crystal armour, a heavy ice crystal pauldron and a wide ice belt, thick stone arms with big fists and thick legs with big dark slate feet, cold mist curling off its shoulders; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:FIGHTER: Subject: Yeti portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute snow ape: a huge round head of shaggy warm white and cream fur shaded taupe grey, a dark slate face with small bright friendly eyes and a wide mouth with two small white fangs, broad furry shoulders, and the top of a pale ivory bone club crusted with ice crystals raised beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:RAIDER: Subject: Sled driver portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute ice-age sled driver: a friendly face with weathered light tan skin and rosy cheeks inside a big cream fur hood, a dark brown-grey fur parka, one arm raised whirling a bolas with two round ice crystal weights above the head, and the grey-and-white head of a husky dog beside the shoulder.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:MARKSMAN: Subject: Snow Hunter portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute ice-age hunter: a friendly face with weathered light tan skin and rosy cheeks inside a big cream fur-trimmed hood, a dark brown-grey fur parka, and a pale ivory bone harpoon with a sharp ice crystal tip resting on the shoulder.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:GUARD: Subject: Mammoth portrait, the head and shoulders of a chunky cute woolly mammoth: a big domed head of shaggy warm cream-to-tan wool, small dark friendly eyes, a dark slate trunk curled up and two long curved pale ivory tusks with frost on their tips.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN: Subject: Ice Witch portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute young witch: a pale cream face with rosy cheeks and big friendly eyes, long straight snow-white hair, a tall crown of sharp ice crystal shards, a deep navy blue robe with a short white fur collar, and the big ice crystal on top of her staff beside her head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT: Subject: Boulder Yeti portrait, head and shoulders of a big chunky cute snow ape: a huge round head of shaggy warm cream fur shaded taupe grey, a dark charcoal slate face with small bright eyes, and both big dark slate hands lifting a round grey boulder crusted with ice crystals above the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:KNIGHT: Subject: Sabretooth portrait, the head of a chunky cute sabre-toothed cat: a big round pale cream-white snow-leopard head with a few soft taupe-grey spots, small bright eyes, round ears and two huge long curved ivory fangs hanging below the jaw.
subjects.PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Frost Giant portrait, head and shoulders of a huge chunky giant of ice and rock: a big round head of dark slate grey stone with a long frosty white beard and small bright friendly eyes, and broad shoulders covered by big plates of ice crystal armour.
subjects.CITY:ICE_FOLK:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 ice-age camp, the first of three sizes of one settlement: one round white snow-block igloo with a dark entrance, one small cone tent of pale cream hide on bone poles beside it, a few pale ice blue ice blocks, and one thin tall pale ivory bone pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no wall, no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:ICE_FOLK:2/CALM: Subject: a medium level-2 ice-age village, the second of three sizes of one settlement: three round white snow-block igloos of different sizes and one long low hall of pale ice blocks with a cream hide roof, packed tightly together inside a low wall of white snow blocks, and one thin tall pale ivory bone pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:ICE_FOLK:3/CALM: Subject: a large level-3 ice-age town, the biggest of three sizes of one settlement, crowded and grand: one big domed great hall of white snow blocks and pale ice blue ice blocks in the middle, surrounded and filled from side to side by many round white igloos and two tall towers of stacked ice blocks, inside a low wall of white snow blocks, and one thin very tall pale ivory bone pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:THROW_BOLAS: Subject: a thrown bolas flying through the air: two round weights of pale ice crystal joined by one short curved cream cord, spinning, with two short white motion arcs behind them and a few small white frost sparkles; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:COLD_SNAP: Subject: a burst of frost: one big bold six-pointed ice crystal snowflake in the middle with a ring of short sharp ice shards bursting outward around it and a few small white sparkles; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:SWEEP: Subject: one long curved pale ivory mammoth tusk swinging sideways, with one wide curved white swoosh arc sweeping across in front of it and three small snow puffs; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:ROCKFALL: Subject: one small grey mountain peak with a white snow cap, and one round grey rock crusted with ice crystals tumbling off its top in a short arc, with two small white motion lines; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:PROWL: Subject: a trail of three big round pale cream cat paw prints with dark slate pads, crossing diagonally from the bottom left to the top right; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:SHATTER: Subject: one block of ice bursting apart: many sharp pale ice crystal shards flying outward in every direction from a bright white flash in the middle; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:FORTIFICATION: Subject: Deep Winter: one small round white snow-block igloo with a wide soft white snowdrift spreading out from it in every direction, and three small ice crystal snowflakes falling above it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:EXPLOSIVES: Subject: Brittle: one solid square block of pale ice crystal with a white shine, split by bold dark zigzag cracks across its face, and two small chips breaking off one corner; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:CHILLED: Subject: one bold six-pointed snowflake of ice crystal with thick simple arms, a white centre and a dark outline; flat and simple, symmetrical; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:FROZEN: Subject: one small solid cube of clear ice crystal with a white shine on its top and two small icicles hanging from its front edge; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:SHATTER: Subject: a burst of shattering ice: many sharp angular shards of ice flying outward in every direction from a round white flash in the middle, the shards bright sky blue with white edges and dark blue shading, with a few small white sparkle specks between them; floating in empty space; round overall.
subjects.EFFECT:SHATTER_SHARDS: Subject: a loose scatter of six to eight small sharp angular shards of ice, each a little triangle or splinter, bright sky blue with a white edge and dark blue shading, spread apart in a ring with empty space between them; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:COLD_SNAP: Subject: a ring of frost seen from above: one wide flat round ring made of sharp ice crystal points and small snowflakes, bright sky blue and white with dark blue shading, with empty space in its middle; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:BOLAS: Subject: a thrown bolas spinning: two round weights of bright sky blue ice crystal with white shine and dark blue shading, joined by one short curved pale cream cord, with one short white motion arc; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:FROST_HIT: Subject: a small cluster of frost forming: five sharp ice crystal spikes growing upward and outward from one point like a little star of rime, bright sky blue and white with dark blue shading, with two small white sparkles; floating in empty space.
